idea-plugin.name: Declutter Tree
idea-plugin.description:
Declutter Tree customizes the Project View file ordering in IntelliJ IDEA. It keeps folders on top, groups Java and Kotlin files by declaration type, and lets you anchor specific files to the top or bottom of any directory.

Features

  • Folders on top: Keeps directories pinned above files in all view modes.
  • Top file anchoring: Pin specific files (such as README.md or module-info.java) directly beneath folders, above all other files.
  • Type-based ordering: Groups code files by structure: Interfaces → Abstract Classes → Classes → Records → Enums → Annotations.
  • Alphabetical sorting: Keeps files within each group sorted alphabetically from A to Z.
  • Bottom file anchoring: Pushes designated files (such as package-info.java) to the very bottom of each directory, below all regular files.
  • Configurable settings: Customize which files are pinned to the top or bottom, and toggle type grouping in Settings → Appearance & Behavior → Declutter Tree.

Performance

  • Fast-path in-memory checks without loading syntax trees (ASTs) or hitting disk during tree rendering.
  • Zero object allocations in directories with no matching files.
  • Implements DumbAware so scrolling and rendering remain responsive during background indexing.
  • Preserves Git status colors, bookmarks, breadcrumbs, and selection state.
